schema_version: v0 — migrates into the intention envelope when MAP.md Q6 lands
owner: akiendelllinux_cc_0 (CC) gates writes. The one-blow scope is Akien's ruling at the challenge pass (small N beats a gradient); he owns every gate the migration creates.
intention: EVERY SKILL BECOMES A LEARNING BLOCK IN ONE PASS — the whole roster (node_classes/skill.json members_so_far: /intent, /challenge, /sorted, /note, /commit, /saveslate, /chart, /moreabout, /sail), then the workflows that chain them. Each skill gains the settled anatomy via the shared primitive: a declared input contract at its door, a consumer-typed trace of every firing, a stratum-tagged bullet-list finding at exit, and Akien's gate — bullets in, questions asked, approve or disprove, verdict recorded as a training pair. No skill fires outside the block once migrated.
why: Akien, 2026-08-01: 'thing is, our skill set is small. a complete migration in one blow and then the workflows.' — overruling the challenge pass's gradient-not-mandate finding with the measurement that decides it (N=9). And the tentative conclusion that started the morning: 'we're not dogfooding our most important element in the thing we do EVERY SINGLE DAY.' The builds learn; the building doesn't — this ticket is the building starting to.
traces_to: Law 2 — CP1-CP6 hold in the process that builds the system; this puts the process under the same gates as the product
Law 3 — 'nothing for you to skate with' stays a HYPOTHESIS until refusal and escape rates are measured; this ticket creates the instruments
Law 8 — a migrated skill a hollow build could fake (bullets emitted, nothing recorded, gate skippable) fails its falsifier
the charter-rule every component answers: 'how does this component learn?' — the skills finally answer it about themselves
state: skill@v2: [TICKETME] -> BUILDME -> PROVEME -> WATCHME(akien-gate-dial) -> PROVED (cast at /sorted 2026-08-01 — the casting IS the TICKETME crossing; its BUILDME waits on the primitive proving first, children before parent)

gates.prove_gate: derivation gate — cairnmap recompiles green: every migrated skill renders from its charter, no charter-less surface appears (the skill class's own prove_gate, real since 2026-07-31).
gates.proof_gate: each child's migration carries proof teeth through the tester where it touches code.
gates.durability_gate: not done until proven AND committed (git).

watchme.trigger: every gate verdict Akien records through the primitive — approve, disprove, or question, on any migrated skill's firing
watchme.enough: the first delegation: Akien hands one gate to its trained inspector on the strength of the match rate — the loop is thereby demonstrated to close. He may also retire the watch by ruling.
watchme.carrier: a verdict artifact against THIS ticket's falsifier: per-gate match-rate report (inspector prediction vs Akien verdict, with firings and refusals as denominators)
watchme.nexus: the inspector's training store, CairnCommons/learning/ — each verdict pair teaches the gate it fired at
watchme.consumer: Akien — the delegation decision is his, and the dial is what he reads to make it

falsifier: RED, by physics, on any of: (1) a migrated skill fires and leaves no trace — greens included; the unrecorded green destroys the denominator; (2) a skill reaches its exit without emitting a bullet-list finding, or emits bullets no gate ever sees; (3) Akien's verdict exists only in conversation — a gate act that leaves no training pair is the compiled inference lost, the exact defect the morning's first ruling (edges-become-open-questions) names; (4) a skill in the roster is not migrated and the ticket claims done — one blow means the SET, and node_classes/skill.json members_so_far is the measured roster; (5) the anatomy is prose in SKILL.md rather than a call into the primitive — discipline wearing physics' clothes; (6) send-back exists but nothing ever fires it across the first measurement window while inputs are demonstrably imperfect — a gate that cannot red is vacuous (the coin-toss-green lesson).
horizon: Re-read after the first full week of gated firings: the dial's numbers exist by then or the watch itself has failed. The workflows-after-skills half re-enters /sorted as its own cast when the skill half proves.
distinctions_recorded: ONE BLOW IS SCOPE, NOT SEQUENCE. The set converts in one campaign, but children still prove before the parent and the primitive proves before any child — foundation order inside the blow.

AKIEN'S GATE-LOAD IS THE DESIGNED BOTTLENECK, named at settlement: he is the ground truth being learned. First delegation targets are whichever gates eat his minutes fastest — the dial reports exactly that.

THE SWEEP IS NOT HERE. build-until-nothing-moves stays a HELD NODE (notes/held-build-until-nothing-moves.json) — it wants this anatomy to exist and the parked-status cut that still awaits Akien; casting it today would build on an unpoured foundation.

The one-blow scope, the Learning Block name (DECIDED), the inspector-bullet gate mechanism, and 'i have become the enforcer. and trainer.' are all Akien's words from that settlement. Superclaude instrumentation (logger_for_bash forensic trace on every run) rides child a's build as the trace lane's first proof-of-pattern — named in the sequencing read, not a separate ticket.
filed_edges: [AKIEN] SCOPE ORDER, NOT SHAPE. The ruling is all 9 in one blow. But two other open items — sorted-renders-the-cursor and the-slate-door-has-a-side-path — are edits to skills inside that same roster, so doing the migration first means touching those two skills twice. Either they land first and the migration sweeps a settled roster, or the migration goes first and absorbs them. Cheap to decide, expensive to get backwards.

[CORPUS] WHAT IS THE PROOF THAT THE MIGRATION IS COMPLETE? 'This skill fires and leaves a trace' is checkable per skill. 'All 9 are migrated' has no tooth unless the roster is COMPILED from what is on disk rather than listed by hand — a hand-listed roster of 9 is a tenth artifact to maintain, and the one most likely to go stale the moment a skill is added.
